text:
omar_ali: Quick heads up  we have an onsite loop booked for candidate Aisha Khan next Mon 09:30-13:00 local. She requested an accessible workstation (sit-stand desk) and a Windows loaner with Docker + cudatoolkit for a short model run. Can ops confirm availability?

liz_hr: Hiring lead here please confirm ASL interpreter first. Also note Aisha is requesting reimbursement in GBP and will need a visa support letter.

sam_it: We have a WinDev laptop (Win11, RTX 2080) available. I can image it with Docker Desktop + WSL2 + CUDA. Do you want us to pre-pull the docker image `company/test-eval:latest` (2.4GB)?

facilities: We can set up a sit-stand station in Conf B (floor 3). I'll reserve a quiet corner and add an accessibility placard. Do we need a parking validation or public transit directions on the invite?

omar_ali: Yes include transit + 3hr parking validation. Also candidate dietary: vegan + tree-nut allergy  so single sealed meals.

sam_it: Pre-pulling the image is fine. Please confirm whether the eval needs internet access or should be staged offline. Offline staging reduces risk. Also request their SSH public key if they want persistent access.

liz_hr: Please stage offline if possible. Aisha asked to run a 5-10 minute inference check only, no internet. I'll request SSH key from candidate right now.

recruiter_bot: (automated) Aisha Khan  travel: Manchester, prefers GBP reimbursement. Visa type: Business visit support letter requested. Email: a.khan@example.co.uk

sam_it: Noted. I'll image machine and preload `company/test-eval:latest` to a local registry mirror. Also will enable ethernet and plug in a Logitech wired mouse + power brick.

facilities: Conf B locked 09:00-13:30 for setup/teardown. Zoom passthrough added: https://zoom.company.com/j/222222222. Will request front desk to print "Interview" badge and note accessibility needs.

omar_ali: Can someone draft a short agenda for the invite? Keep it tight: intro, tech, lunch, coding on machine, wrap. Also include interpreter contact and parking code.

sam_it: Agenda snippet to paste into invite:
```
09:00  setup + laptop check
09:30  Intro / Hiring manager (Liz)
10:00  System design (Eng)
10:45  Lunch + buffer (boxed)
11:15  Hands-on eval (on loaner)
12:00  Wrap / recruiter next steps
```

liz_hr: I'll draft the visa support letter and send for review. Omar please confirm hotel courtesy if arrival before 8pm.

omar_ali: We're offering one-night courtesy hotel for arrivals before 10pm. I'll message candidate and update the invite.

recruiter_bot: (automated) Calendar invite created and sent to a.khan@example.co.uk, Liz, Sam, Omar. Invite ID: 1860427890-akhn.

sam_it: Tiny note: if you want GPU access from the machine we need to enable `nvidia-docker` runtime; it's included in the image. Confirmed offline datastore path: `\\10.20.1.5\registry\company-test` (internal).

facilities: Catering ordered: single sealed vegan meal, allergy card attached. Parking validation: 3 hours via code `PK-449`. Will paste into invite.

omar_ali: Thanks all. I'll follow up once SSH key and visa letter draft are done. If interpreter not available I'll book remote ASL via vendor.

liz_hr: :thumbsup: appreciate the quick turn. One last thing please make sure security knows to escort candidate to Conf B and that the sit-stand desk is lowered upon arrival.

omaar_ali (typo correction): pinging to say all set, interpreter booked remote, machine imaged, invite updated with transit and parking. Closing loop.

sam_it: Confirmed machine sealed and labelled. I'll drop it off at front desk at 08:45.

recruiter_bot: (automated) Candidate confirmed travel itinerary. End of thread.
